information: The only events at this competition will be 3x3x3 Multiple Blindfolded, 3x3x3 Fewest Moves, 4x4x4 Blindfolded, and 5x5x5 blindfolded.  First-time competitors are welcome, however we will not be holding the normal speedsolving events, and so you may prefer to attend a different competition.
